latest_version_code.description: PRODUCTION family channel. Do not bump on a routine/dev publish — only when explicitly asked.

latest_version_name.description: PRODUCTION family channel. Leave unchanged unless promoting a build to family.

apk_url.description: PRODUCTION family channel. Default publish must not point this at a beta object.

defaultValue.value: Group gates into lists. Take a gate out of a list without deleting it. Hide the searching notice. More reliable opening when the phone is locked.

release_notes.description: PRODUCTION family channel. Optional what's-new text for the in-app update sheet.

beta_version_code.description: BETA channel. Default RC publish updates these keys only. Hidden until developer options are unlocked.

beta_version_name.description: BETA channel. User-facing version name for Check for beta updates.

beta_apk_url.description: BETA channel. HTTPS URL of the beta APK (separate Storage object so family production URL is not overwritten).

defaultValue.value: Widget uses less battery: face ranks from a cached location instead of asking Play Services on every screen-on. Tap still takes a current fix to open.

beta_release_notes.description: BETA channel. Optional what's-new text shown only after unlock.
